method: Performance measurements use fresh public scripts/run_task.py processes launched by the existing benchmark driver. GNU time observes each child peak RSS. Adjacent pairs alternate version order; each fixed configuration retains its order across seeds. The separately labelled record-consistency check calls public run() with a copied example task. No sampling benchmark calls private native entry points.
